messages:
maya: Quick sync request — planning a tenant-level 'reuse heatmap' + eviction attribution for KV/prefix caches. Need runtime + infra inputs to define metrics and a console dashboard. cc @kevin @sasha @chandra
kevin: SG. My high-level ask: 3 core metrics (access, hit, eviction) + one reuse distribution. Keep cardinality low.
kevin: Example labels I care about: cache_type, workload, route, tenant_group (not raw tenant id), prefix_len_bucket
sasha: Agree on tenant_group instead of raw tenant id for privacy and cost. We can hash for internal debug but prod dashboards use group. :thumbsup:
chandra: From runtime side we'll emit counters, but we need to decide: do we emit tenant_group on every event or emit aggregated per-tenant rollups every 10s? High cardinality spikes kill our metrics backend.
oliver: Suggestion: runtime emits per-route, per-workload aggregates every 10s with labels {cache_type, workload, route, tenant_group, prefix_len_bucket}. Also emit a sampled event stream (1/100) with full tenant id for debugging stored in logs only.
maya: That sounds reasonable. Can you sketch the metric names? We should standardize for the ingestion pipeline and docs.
chandra: Draft metric list:
```
cache_access_total{cache_type="kv|prefix", workload="chat|embed", route="/v1/generate", tenant_group="startup|enterprise", prefix_len_bucket="0|1-8|9-32|33+"}  
cache_hit_total{...}
cache_eviction_total{...}
cache_reuse_samples_total{reuse_count_bucket="1|2-4|5-10|10+", ...} 
```
kevin: +1. For reuse distribution I'd prefer a histogram-ish buckets rather than many unique counts. That makes Grafana transforms simpler.
sasha: Where do we compute derived metrics (hit rate, reuse_pct)? In Grafana or precomputed in metrics backend?
maya: Ops prefers derived in dashboard to avoid metric churn, but we might precompute an hourly aggregated hit_rate for SLAs. Thoughts?
oliver: Precompute a daily and hourly rollup for SLAs, dashboard live view uses raw counters to compute instant hit rate. Keeps flexibility.
amy: UX/console note: product wants a matrix heatmap view where x=prefix_len_bucket, y=tenant_group, cell color = reuse_pct. Also an eviction overlay and top-5 routes per cell. Need API to map route -> human label.
chandra: We'll export route label as route_id and pipeline will join route metadata for console. Route metadata service owner: @amy.
amy: I'll own the metadata join and small API. Need a contract: route_id + display_name + product_team.
kevin: Alerts: propose SLO guard rails: if global hit_rate drops >5% vs baseline for 5m, raise P2. If any tenant_group drops >20% for 10m, paging. We'll need aggregate and per-tenant_group evaluation.
sasha: One more: eviction attribution — we need to emit reason label: reason="capacity|ttl|manual" so infra can separate churn vs TTL.
chandra: runtime will add eviction_reason label. We'll limit reasons to that enum.
maya: Next: telemetry pipeline. infra-bot will need to accept these metric names; we must add a new ingest schema and a sampling flow. @oliver can you open the infra change?
oliver: I'll open PR for ingest schema + OTLP transform today. Plan: ingest -> prom-remote-write -> rollups job -> grafana datasource. Sampling config: 1/100 for full tenant id events, default is aggregate emits.
infra-bot: infra: created ticket INFRA-3421 for metric ingest changes, pinged eng-infra for quota/rollout.
amy: Timeline: aim for prototype dashboard in dev console next week, staged rollout to prod in two sprints. Owners: maya (metrics design), chandra (runtime), oliver (ingest), amy (console).
maya: Follow-up: 30m sync Wednesday 10:30 to finalize labels and dashboard mock. I'll share a wireframe + example panels beforehand. :calendar:
kevin: Thanks — I've added SLI/SLO draft to the ticket. :eyes:
maya: Linking draft dashboard (dev): https://grafana.internal/d/abcd/reuse-heatmap (will be populated after infra changes)
kevin: :thumbsup:
